properties.citation: J. Vansina, « Le royaume du Kongo et ses voisins », Histoire générale de l'Afrique, vol. IV, UNESCO, 1985, p. 621: « Soyo entre le fleuve et l'Océan, Mbamba au sud de Soyo ; Nsundi et le Nord-Est, Mbangu [Mpangu] au sud de Nsundi, Mbata dans l'Est et Mbenba [Mpemba] avec la capitale au centre »; Histoire générale de l'Afrique, vol. V, UNESCO, 1999, p. 605: about 1500 the border followed the river from its mouth to the Inkisi confluence.
properties.derivation: Built by social/video/areas.mjs, an estimation (approximate zone rule): the anchor « Mbenba avec la capitale au centre »: the capital, Mbanza-Congo, at 14.24, -6.27; the land of Natural Earth's countries within one step (1°) of it and nearer to it than to the five other anchors, south of the kingdom's border c. 1500 (the Congo of social/video/data/rivers/congo.geojson from the Inkisi confluence, the last point of Natural Earth's Inkisi at 14.86, -4.76, to its mouth at 12.36, -6.03, midway between Moanda and Soyo; north of the confluence's latitude east of it), each distance given a wobble of ±11 % seeded by the name; on a 0.05° grid (cells whose centre falls inside), traced back as the cell boundary, simplified by Douglas–Peucker at 0.02° and rounded to 0.01°, the largest part kept. No limit of the source is traced: the zone says where the province lay, not its border.
